payload.reason: The evidence describes different stratigraphies and their water retention characteristics, indicating the types of soil retention curves used in the study.

claims.text: The study used three idealized subsurface stratigraphies: blocks only, blocks with sediment, and sediment only, each with different water retention capabilities.
The blocks only stratigraphy has low water retention, while the sediment phases retain significantly more water, indicating varying soil retention curves.
The sediment only stratigraphy serves as a control scenario with high field capacity due to fine-grained sediment, reflecting a specific soil retention curve.
